scope: Phase 1 of the 2026-11-09 review follow-up: reject cookie-authenticated requests from another same-host origin, keep browser-originated app-call chains non-admin, retire the pre-0.5 legacy CLI browser-approval login, restore same-tab in-portal app navigation, and add an exact-SHA CI gate to core-rollout.py. The dev-only portal origin (phase 2) is not part of this record.

source.description: Validated working tree on top of the base commit; the resulting commit is recorded with its CI in the deployment record.

decisions.decision: Add a dev-only portal origin; the existing portal becomes prod-only. Support localhost and single-IP (port-separated) installs as the default; hostnames optional.
Keep the portal (443) and console/Keycloak (9443) publicly reachable; the user states the observed public client IPs are the company network's egress addresses.
decisions.observation: Production Nginx access logs on 2026-11-09: non-loopback clients that reached the console IdP login: private ranges 0, public ranges 2 (addresses not recorded). Host firewall inactive; 9443 listens on all IPv4 addresses. External network filtering not verified (NOT_RUN).

decisions.decision: Retire the pre-0.5 legacy CLI browser-approval flow instead of adding a confirmation code (the request ID is visible in the approval URL, so a code would only add friction). Published CLI 0.7.0 uses the device flow.
In-portal app navigation returns to the same tab; only links to another origin open a new tab.
Deploy phase 1 to production once isolated validation and exact-SHA CI pass.

changes: crates/miy/src/http.rs: foreign_cookie_request rejects cookie-authenticated requests whose Sec-Fetch-Site is not same-origin/none or whose Origin differs from the listener origin (GET and navigations included), before any session lookup; the explicit development-login web server origin stays allowed on the portal only. /auth/login accepts navigation requests only.
crates/miy/src/runtime.rs, app_calls.rs: the signed identity admin flag is false whenever the call chain started from a browser session, including continuation hops authenticated by miy_call_ tokens.

crates/miy/src/cli_auth.rs, api_error.rs, domain.rs: legacy /auth/cli/start, /auth/cli/exchange and /api/v1/cli-authorizations/{id}/approve answer 410 cli_upgrade_required; issued legacy tokens stay valid until expiry and remain listable/revocable.
web/platform/src/pages/CliAuthorize.tsx: the console shows an upgrade notice instead of an approval button.
web/platform/src/layout/Shell.tsx, pages/Home.tsx: rail app items and the Home app card use same-tab TanStack links; cross-origin links keep NewTabLink; the console redirect fallback is a plain link.
scripts/core-rollout.py, scripts/test-core-ops.py: preflight requires the latest main-push run of web.yml, cli-foundation.yml and runtime-regression.yml for the exact commit, all jobs successful.
scripts/check-write-decisions.py: retired legacy handlers removed from the transaction/writer allowlist.

Tests and checks: browser_boundary_regression.rs (cross-origin cookie requests, retired legacy flow), permissions_regression.rs (admin browser chain), check-http-server.py, check-architecture.mjs, Playwright specs reverting same-origin new-tab assertions.
Docs: APP-BOUNDARIES, CHECKS, CLI-IMPLEMENTATION-PLAN, CLI-VALIDATION-MATRIX, PRD, RUNNING, SERVER-OPERATIONS, UIUX-MIGRATION, WINDOWS-ACCEPTANCE, PLAN.
